title: consolidate-auth-context-and-stream-helpers-across-py-ts-go
author: Ava Morales
description: Motivation: developer friction and duplicated logic across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs for credential lifecycle, retry semantics, and streaming ergonomics slowed maintenance and introduced subtle parity bugs. This PR introduces a compact AuthContext abstraction plus a small set of stream helper primitives and retry-presets to harmonize behavior across SDKs. Scope: 1) add AuthContext surface (token provider, ttl hint, heartbeat hook, on-revoke) and language-idiomatic adapters for Py/TS/Go; 2) add lightweight stream helpers (peekable async iterator, buffered-chunk iterator, resume hint metadata) to improve consumer ergonomics and make graceful reauth/resume deterministic across SDKs; 3) expose three shared retry presets (fast-fail, balanced, resilient) and wire them into the streaming client default; 4) bump package versions: python 3.7.4 -> 3.8.0, typescript 1.27.3 -> 1.28.0, go v1.12.8 -> v1.13.0; 5) fix parity bugs found in TS/Go backpressure handling and Py stream cancellation. Checklist: - [x] design doc referenced (Linear ENG-2145) - [x] implement core AuthContext shim in each SDK - [x] unit and integration tests added for reauth scenario - [x] update changelogs and examples - [x] coordinate version bumps in CI pipeline Backwards compatibility: AuthContext adapters are additive; default behavior remains unchanged. Rollout: feature flags in place to gradually enable new retry preset as default for hosted streaming routes. Related: Linear ENG-2145, ENG-2146, ENG-2148. Links: design doc https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-2145/unify-auth-context, test matrix https://ci.redwood.internal/build/219337
commits: 5 commits: initial-auth-context-shim (adds interfaces and basic tests); ts-adapter (typescript adapter + docs); py-adapter (python adapter + async iterator helpers); go-adapter (go adapter + stream resume hints); bump-versions-and-changelog
ci_details: CI: initial run reported 2 flaky stream tests failing on linux-amd64 (py test_stream_resume). Rerun for flaky tests only after test timeout increased; second run green. Lint/format checks passed for all SDKs. Integration matrix (py/ts/go) passed on second try. Coverage delta +1.2% on SDK tests.
review_comments: Riley Chen: Left a note on the TS adapter where the heartbeat hook lacks jitter. Recommend adding small randomized jitter to avoid thundering reauth events.
Samir Patel: Found a race in Go stream close path when reauth happens concurrently with Cancel(). Suggested synchronizing via context.Done() selection and added test.
Claire Nguyen: Can we keep an escape hatch to opt out of new default retry preset for Dedicated customers? Suggested feature flag and API to pin existing retry profile per-client.
Infra Bot: integration tests queued on us-west-2; estimated runtime 12m.
author_responses: Ava Morales: Added jitter parameter to TS heartbeat and document default (100-400ms). Updated tests to cover jitter behavior.
Ava Morales: Addressed Go race by making Cancel idempotent and introducing a lightweight close mutex in stream helper. Added targeted unit test 'TestStreamCancelDuringReauth'.
Ava Morales: Added client opt-out flag 'retry_profile: legacy' and documented in dedicated migration guide.
release_notes: - Add AuthContext abstraction and language adapters for Python/TypeScript/Go; - Introduce stream helper primitives (peekable iterator, buffered-chunks, resume hints) to improve reauth/resume ergonomics; - Add three retry presets (fast-fail, balanced, resilient); - Fix parity bugs in TS/Go backpressure and Py cancellation; - Bump Python SDK to 3.8.0, TS SDK to 1.28.0, Go SDK to v1.13.0
